vo.text: A moment when God showed up, and a song made all the difference.
This is the Testimonies of Praise app.
Watch powerful testimonies of healing, deliverance, and miracles. Real stories, from people whose lives were touched by the songs of the LoveWorld Singers.
Prefer to read? Written testimonies are right there too.
Join the live broadcast, and chat with others as it happens. Not live yet? Watch a testimony while you wait.
When the radio is on air, keep listening, even with your screen locked.
Ask Praxiom to help you find a testimony, or find your way around.
Save testimonies to watch offline, wherever you are.
Worship with the LoveWorld Singers, discover the meaning behind the songs, and share your own testimony.
Because no one ever praised God, and went away empty.
Download Testimonies of Praise, free on the LoveWorld App Store.
Just scan the QR code to download the app.
Thank you, and God bless you.
